criteria.label: Товарнинг зарур техник тавсифига қўйиладиган талаблар. Техник топшириқда назарда тутилган хажм, техник параметрлар ва талабларига мувофиқлиги. Иштирокчилар хар бир талаб бўйича асословчи ҳужжатларни илова қилади.

subject_uz: MTS (mobil aloqa) majmuasini o'rnatish uchun tirkama ko'rinishidagi mobil ko'chma stansiyalar (15 ta kompleks)

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif texnik topshiriqning 1-ilovasidagi talablarga to'liq mos bo'lishi va to'ldirilgan moslik jadvali (SoC) bilan tasdiqlanishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The bid must fully match the requirements in Annex 1 of the technical assignment and be backed by a completed compliance table (SoC).
requirements.quote: Texnik topshiriqning 1-ilovasida keltirilgan talablar bilan moslik

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik baholash 100 balldan iborat, o'tish bali 99; narx bo'yicha eng past takliflar usuli qo'llaniladi.
requirements.summary_en: Technical scoring is out of 100 with a pass mark of 99; the lowest-price method is used.

requirements.summary_uz: Takliflar eng past narx usuli bo'yicha baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Bids are evaluated by the lowest-price method.
requirements.quote: Taklifni baholash usuli: Eng past narx usuli

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur moliyaviy resurslar mavjudligi haqida kafolat xati (4-ilova) taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: A guarantee letter (Annex 4) confirming the financial resources needed to perform the contract must be provided.
requirements.quote: shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur moliyaviy resurslarning mavjudligi to‘g‘risidagi kafolat xati

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi bankdan 5-ilova shaklidagi ma'lumotnoma (bank xati) taqdim etishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must submit a bank letter in the Annex 5 form.
requirements.quote: Bank (kreditlar, bank kafolatlari, akkreditivlar, kafolatlar, lizing) yoki uchinchi shaxslar oldida majburiyatlari mavjud emas

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi asosiy benefitsiar haqidagi ma'lumotlarni oshkor qilishi kerak (1-ilova).
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must disclose its ultimate beneficial owner (Annex 1).
requirements.quote: asosiy benefisiar tog‘risidagi ma’lumotlarni oshkor qilish (Xarid qilish hujjatiga 1-ilova);

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat xatida (2-ilova) ishtirokchi va uning ta'sischilari, direktorida tugallanmagan ishlar yo'qligi tasdiqlanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The guarantee letter (Annex 2) must confirm there are no unfinished cases against the company, its founders or director.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi kompaniyasida, shu jumladan uning ta’sischilarida, direktorida tugallanmagan jinoiy, ma’muriy yoki iqtisodiy yoki soliq bilan bog‘liq ishlar

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif taqdim etish muddati tugaganidan keyin kamida 60 kun amal qilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bid must remain valid for at least 60 days after the submission deadline.
requirements.quote: takliflar taqdim etish tugagan kundan boshlab kamida 60 kun bo‘lishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma qiymatining 15 foizi avans sifatida to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 15% of the contract value is paid as an advance.

requirements.summary_uz: Qolgan 85 foiz to'liq hajm yetkazilib hujjatlar imzolangandan keyin 90 kalendar kun ichida to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The remaining 85% is paid within 90 calendar days after documents for the full volume are signed.
requirements.quote: Tovarning qiymatining 85 foizi (sakson besh foizi) miqdorida

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib berish muddati 90 ish kuni, manzil Toshkent shahri, Farg'ona yo'li, 15; miqdori 15 ta kompleks.
requirements.summary_en: Delivery is within 90 working days to Tashkent, Fergana road 15; quantity is 15 complexes.
requirements.quote: Yetkazib berish muddati: 90 ish kuni ichida.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (18-bet): 5-ilova shaklidagi bank xatida ishtirokchining bank yoki uchinchi shaxslar oldida hech qanday majburiyati (kredit, kafolat, lizing) yo'qligi tasdiqlanishi kerak. Shakl bo'yicha taqdim etilmagan hujjat malakaviy bosqichda chetlashtirishga olib keladi, shuning uchun oddiy kredit liniyasi yoki lizingi bo'lgan, 4 032 000 000 so'mlik lotni bajara oladigan ishtirokchilar ham chetlashtirilishi mumkin.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (3-bet): Kafolat xatida ishtirokchi, uning har bir ta'sischisi va direktorida tugallanmagan har qanday ma'muriy, iqtisodiy yoki soliq ishi yo'qligi tasdiqlanishi talab qilinadi. Kichik ma'muriy ish ham ishtirokchini malakaviy bosqichda chetlashtirishi mumkin va talab ishlarni bajarish qobiliyatiga aloqador emas.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (19-bet): Bir gapda bank xati taklif muddati tugashidan kamida 30 kun oldin berilgan bo'lishi, ayni paytda 30 kundan eski bo'lmasligi kerakligi aytilgan; bu ikki talab bir-biriga zid. Taklif muddati 7 kun ekanini hisobga olsak, noaniqlik xatni to'g'ri tayyorlagan ishtirokchini chetlashtirishga olib kelishi mumkin.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 187 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 3 ta; savdolarning 36% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 6%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 29 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 18): The Annex 5 bank letter must state the bidder has no obligations to a bank or third parties (loans, guarantees, leasing). A document not in the set form leads to disqualification at the qualification stage, so capable bidders with an ordinary credit line or lease could be excluded from this 4,032,000,000 UZS lot.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 3): The guarantee letter must state that the company, each founder and the director have no unfinished administrative, economic or tax case of any kind. Even a minor administrative matter could exclude a bidder at the qualification stage, though it need not relate to ability to perform.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 19): One sentence says the bank letter must be issued at least 30 days before the deadline and also that it must not be older than 30 days; the two cannot both hold. With a 7-day bidding window this ambiguity could disqualify a bidder who prepared the letter in good faith.
In the customer's last 187 deals the median number of bidders was 3; 36% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 6%.
Note: 29 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
